stem: During a 2-week promotion on a 65-inch TV, Voltmarkt counts soundbars as the linked category. Neither soundbar was on promotion. Soundbar Mini sold 6, 4 and 6 units in three of the 4 weeks before the promotion; in the remaining week it sold nothing, so the sales data has no row for that week. During the promotion Mini sold 9 and 11 units. Soundbar Max sold 10, 12, 8 and 10 units in the 4 weeks before, and 15 and 17 units during the promotion. Voltmarkt's halo adds up, over the linked category's products, (average weekly units during the promotion - baseline) × the number of promotion weeks. The baseline is the average weekly units in the 4 weeks before the promotion, with a week without sales counted as 0. What is the halo, in soundbar units? Give a whole number.
